documents.text:
October 28, 2026

The Honorable Debbie-Anne Reese, Secretary
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, D.C. 20426

Re: 	Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC, IN79-6-000
FERC Form 580
Request for Privileged and Confidential Treatment of Question 5
Dear Secretary Bose:
Pursuant to Part 35 of the regulations of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (“FERC” or “Commission”), Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC (“DEC”) hereby submits for filing a request for privileged and confidential treatment of the enclosed response to Question 5 of DEC’s FERC Form 580 for the calendar years 2024 and 2025.  DEC is submitting responses to Questions 1 through 4 and Questions 6 through 8 on a public version of FERC Form 580 submitted contemporaneously with this filing.  
If you have any questions regarding this filing, or if we may be of further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact the undersigned.

Respectfully submitted,

/s/ Sheri Hylton May	
Sheri Hylton May
Associate General Counsel
Duke Energy Corporation
1212M / 139 East Fourth Street
Cincinnati, Ohio 45202
office phone: (513) 287-4340
fax: (513) 287-4386
